# `m.reference.market_status`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Whether the markets are open now, by exchange, currency market, and index group.

```python
m.reference.market_status()
```

| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AfterHours` | boolean | Whether or not the market is in post-market hours. | REST |
| `CurrenciesCrypto` | String | The status of the crypto market. From the `currencies` object: Contains the status of various currency markets. | REST |
| `CurrenciesFx` | String | The status of the forex market. From the `currencies` object: Contains the status of various currency markets. | REST |
| `EarlyHours` | boolean | Whether or not the market is in pre-market hours. | REST |
| `ExchangesNasdaq` | String | The status of the Nasdaq market. From the `exchanges` object: Contains the status of different US stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq, NYSE). | REST |
| `ExchangesNyse` | String | The status of the NYSE market. From the `exchanges` object: Contains the status of different US stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq, NYSE). | REST |
| `ExchangesOtc` | String | The status of the OTC market. From the `exchanges` object: Contains the status of different US stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq, NYSE). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsCccy` | String | The status of Cboe Streaming Market Indices Cryptocurrency ("CCCY") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsCgi` | String | The status of Cboe Global Indices ("CGI") trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsDowJones` | String | The status of Dow Jones indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsFtseRussell` | String | The status of Financial Times Stock Exchange Group ("FTSE") Russell indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsMsci` | String | The status of Morgan Stanley Capital International ("MSCI") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsMstar` | String | The status of Morningstar ("MSTAR") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsMstarc` | String | The status of Morningstar Customer ("MSTARC") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsNasdaq` | String | The status of National Association of Securities Dealers Automated Quotations ("Nasdaq") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsSAndP` | String | The status of Standard & Poor's ("S&P") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `IndicesGroupsSocieteGenerale` | String | The status of Societe Generale indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). | REST |
| `Market` | String | The status of the market as a whole. | REST |
| `ServerTime` | Instant | The current time of the server, returned as a date-time in RFC3339 format. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
